name: compass-claude-plugins
description: Internal Claude plugins for Compass Datacenters finance and project controls.

plugins.name: netsuite-approval-review
plugins.description: Double-checks the NetSuite bills and change orders in your approval queue and publishes findings to a live dashboard you can approve or reject from.

plugins.name: procore-open-items-review
plugins.description: Reviews the Procore items actually waiting on your workflow response — change risks, subcontractor invoices and commitment change orders — and publishes findings to a live dashboard you can respond from.
